description: Dashboard shell: native HTTP and WebSocket to any user-specified backend, plus custom-title-bar window controls. The `:*` in the http scope is load-bearing: these are URLPattern constructor strings, not globs, and a pattern with no port component parses to port "", which matches only a URL whose port is the scheme default. `http://*` would therefore reject every Mihomo address the user actually types (http://127.0.0.1:9090, http://192.168.1.5:9090) while still allowing the GitHub release check over implicit 443 — do not 'tidy' the `:*` away.
